cases.purpose: resolver-serve --recurse --root-hints follows referrals from a controlled root through a TLD server to the authoritative server and returns the answer (r3).
cases.oracle: RFC 1034 s4.3.2 iterative resolution against a Python root/TLD/authority chain on 127.0.0.2/3/4 (referrals with glue); BIND dig is the independent client and the per-tier query log is recorded by the peer.
cases.comparison: One candidate resolver run with BASHDNS_SERVER_PORT redirecting iterative queries to port 5330 and root hint 127.0.0.2; dig queries it once; the client answer and the ordered root, tld, auth queries are checked.
cases.script:
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/mig-w2-recurse.py
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" serve ready 2> tiers.err &
tiers=$!
exec 7<>w.fifo
for i in {1..100}; do [[ -e ready ]] && break; read -t 0.05 -u 7 l; done
BASHDNS_SERVER_PORT=5330 dns resolver-serve --listen 127.0.0.1 --port 5320 --root-hints 127.0.0.2 --max-queries 1 --timeout 3000 < /dev/null 2> resolver.err &
res=$!
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" waitudp 5320
/usr/bin/dig +tries=1 +time=6 -p 5320 @127.0.0.1 www.x.test A > dig.out 2>&1
wait "$res"
echo "resolver-rc=$?"
kill "$tiers"; wait "$tiers" 2>/dev/null
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" verify
